summary: Creation of a new scenario used to detect low value Corp Cross border payments being sent to a new and unknown beneficiaries when a threshold of new bene payments has been breached.
fdesc: This scenario is looking for Corp payments in <5K value range, to new (less than 2 days old) and unknown beneficiaries. The threshold of payments to new beneficiaries in a rolling 4 hours must also be 5 or more and the value to new bene's in that same period has exceeded 10k. The value of 10k was chosen as a reasonable materiality factor based on the fact that losses below this value are manageable within the BRT limits. In this case the ROVA outcome will be HOLD, all corp scenarios are now designed to be holds due to the exceptional friction generated by STOPS.
evid_desc: This scenario's design was not inspired by any particular case and is acting as a theoretical risk scenario.
